text:
Subject: Launch Update & Next Steps for October 8

Hi Avery,

I am writing to share an update on our launch position. While our tentative launch was scheduled for October 8, 2026, our release requires a completed security approval. Nia is leading the security review, which will now finish on October 12 at the earliest. 

Ensuring this approval is finalized reflects our commitment to a secure release. Because the review may require remediation, no new production date is authorized yet. We will keep you updated as Nia’s review progresses.

In the meantime, our team is ready to maintain momentum. We can hold a staging demo on October 8 using synthetic data. 

Please let me know if you would like to proceed with the staging demo on October 8 so we can finalize the arrangements.

Best regards,

Jordan  
Engagement Lead
